fact: Decree 2021-913 of 22 December 2021 (Presidency, on the joint report of the digital economy and public service ministers) adopts the Référentiel Général d'Interopérabilité des Systèmes d'Information, annexed to the decree, as the general framework of technical rules for interoperability of information systems; the annex lists recommended, under-observation and end-of-life standards.
